name: Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited
shareholdingPatternNotes: A.  Pursuant to the Debt Resolution Plan, the Company had signed a Framework Agreement (the Agreement) with the Banks and Financial Institutions for restructuring of the outstanding Loans and Interest thereon.  In terms of the Agreement and as agreed upon, the Company has allotted Unlisted Fully paid up 0.01% Cumulative Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) for an aggregate amount of Rs.3,80,553 lakhs to its lenders on private placement basis upon conversion of Debt. The CCPs have maturity of 29 years and shall be converted into such number of Equity Shares as may be determined at the time of conversion as per prevailing provision of Companies Act/SEBI/RBI Rules and Regulations. In the absence of determinability of number of equity shares to be issued upon conversion of CCPS, the equity capital on diluted basis is shown Zero.   B.  Pursuant to an Agreement 20.05.2026, executed pursuant to the approval of the resolution plan submitted by Adani Enterprises Limited as approved by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Allahabad Bench by way of the order dated 17.03.2026 read with the rectification order dated 08.05.2026 (Resolution Plan), approving the Resolution plan of erstwhile promoter of the Company - Jaiprakash Associates Limited  (JAL) in favour of Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL), the successful bidder, as per which 24% shareholding of Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited (JPVL) held by erstwhile Promoter of the Company  Jaiprakash Associates Limited has been transferred to Adani Power Limited (APL), the implementation agency. As such, APL has now become the Promoter of the Company. Necessary disclosures in this respect have been filed with stock exchanges in this respect from time to time.   C. The shares pledged by Promoters comprise of 120,05,09,465 Shares pledged and 10,21,88,566 Shares put under Non Disposal Undertaking (NDU)
